title: Constant coefficients and derived adjunctions on strict pro-etale towers
statement: Let $B$ be a commutative ring. For every scheme $X$ use its small pro-etale site with the chosen small skeleton, its constant ring sheaf $\underline B_X$, the abelian category of module sheaves, and $\mathcal T_X=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{op},\operatorname{Mod}(\underline B_X))$ of strict inverse systems. Work in the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(\mathcal T_X)$. Use the termwise inverse image $G_u$, total derived termwise direct image $R_u$, and exact open extension $J_j$ with their specified adjunctions and compositors [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations] [def-cbc-strict-tower-open-extension]. For every scheme map $u:X\to Y$, the canonical constant-section map $c_u:u^{-1}\underline B_Y\to\underline B_X$ is an isomorphism of ring sheaves, natural in $B$, compatible with ring homomorphisms, identities and composition. Termwise module inverse image using $c_u$ is exact and left adjoint to termwise direct image. The categories $\mathcal T_X$ are module-sheaf categories on the small diagram sites of [lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-realization] and are Grothendieck abelian; every complex admits a K-injective resolution. Termwise direct image preserves K-injective complexes. Its total unbounded derived functor is everywhere defined, and the derived adjunction $G_u\dashv R_u$ has the unit and counit induced by the termwise adjunction. For every open immersion $j$, termwise extension by zero and restriction are exact and induce $J_j\dashv G_j$ with the termwise open unit and counit. These assertions hold for infinite $B$ and unbounded tower complexes, without transition-surjectivity or uniform-boundedness hypotheses.

proof.text: Use constantRing_isIso and constantRingIso_comp from [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations] for invertibility and composition. The proved proEtaleConstantInverseImageMap_naturality declaration of [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-coefficient-inverse-image] is stated for arbitrary CommRingCat objects and gives coefficient naturality, without finiteness. For the identity, transpose under the actual sheaf adjunction. Sheafification uniqueness and naturality of toSheafify show that the direct-image constant-section map is the inverse component of the canonical direct-image identity isomorphism. The conjugation unit identity then gives exactly leftAdjointIdIso, not an arbitrary isomorphism.

Specialize the module and tower finite-limit/finite-colimit instances of [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations]. Whiskering the specified module adjunction produces termwiseAdjunction. Its unit and counit at each index reduce definitionally to the specified module unit and counit.

Construct the vertical topology with verticalDiagramSiteTopology from [lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-topology]. Its existing generalized sheaf criterion applies with index N^op and the larger small pro-etale model. Reproduce the component, horizontal-arrow and assembly constructions of [lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-module-equivalence] privately with independent index universe Type and site universe u+1, retaining their formulas. Restricting along a vertical slice gives the component module; assembling a diagram uses the horizontal map followed by the vertical restriction. Commutation follows from module-map naturality. The component identity isomorphisms give the unit and counit, with triangle identity componentwise. Compose this explicit equivalence with postcomposition by the module pushforward equivalence for AsSmall.equiv from [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Its underlying ring presheaf and vertical covers are the displayed ones by reduction. An equivalence preserves finite limits and colimits; preservation of binary products gives additivity.

The module category is Grothendieck by modules_grothendieck in [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations], which specializes [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist] at the original site universes. Take a separator H of modules. For each index j take its free diagram under the evaluation left adjoint. These form a separating family: a component map detected by H transposes under evaluation to a detecting map from the free diagram. Their coproduct is a separator. Filtered colimits and AB5 transfer pointwise by the Mathlib functor-category instances. This proves Grothendieck abelianness directly, without transferring through a chosen diagram-site equivalence. The existing towers_kInjective instance then supplies a K-injective resolution of every complex; retain its quasi-isomorphism and forget the additional monomorphism property.

Apply the proved upstream Adjunction.preservesKInjectiveComplexes lemma to termwiseAdjunction. Tower pullback is exact, hence preserves homology. The lemma transposes a map from an acyclic complex into the direct image of I, null-homotopes its adjunct into I, and transports the homotopy back. This uses K-injectivity in the tower category itself, not levelwise K-injectivity.

Unfold R only and use the standard rightDerivedFunctor IsRightDerivedFunctor instance; its unit is an isomorphism at a K-injective complex by the upstream homotopy-category K-injective derivability instance. The adjunction equality is definitional from adj and termwiseAdjunction in [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations]. For an open immersion all four exactness instances and the normalized jAdj equality are already supplied by [def-cbc-strict-tower-open-extension], the last again definitionally. Thus the existing constructions retain their specified termwise normalizations without a fresh choice of adjunction.
